description: The session state protocol for AI coding. Hook-level scope enforcement, cross-session memory, contradiction detection, and predictive context - Claude is stateless, your project isn't.

# ⚡ OptimusPrime *Claude forgets. OptimusPrime doesn't.* Four hooks. Four problems solved. Nothing else. --- ## Before / After ``` Day 2, new session. You: fix the auth bug we were working on Claude: I'd be happy to help! Could you tell me about your authentication system? You: [explains everything again] Claude: [suggests the approach you already rejected, touches the file you said was frozen] ``` ``` Day 2, new session. You: fix the auth bug we were working on Claude: Context restored — JWT middleware refactor. 18 decisions. 3 past failures. Scope locked. Continuing from: implement refresh token rotation. ``` --- ## What it does | | What it fixes | |---|---| | **Scope guard** | Claude touching files it shouldn't. Every write to an out-of-scope file is blocked before execution — not a suggestion, a hook. | | **Loop detector** | Claude retrying what already failed. Warns at 3 failures across any tool. Blocks at 5. Shows every prior attempt so Claude can't re-try the same thing. | | **Session memory** | Re-explaining everything next session. Decisions, failures, goal, next action written to `.optimusprime/` at Stop. Auto-injected on new session start — zero manual paste. | | **Token optimization** | Claude being verbose by default. Output-mode rules injected before every response — word counts, abbreviations, no preamble, no wrap-up, code first. Works from word one. | --- ## Install ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aarshsharma2803-stack/optimusprime/main/install-remote.sh | bash ``` Registers all hooks. Installs 7 skills — everything in one command, no extra steps. Restart Claude Code once. | Skill | Trigger | What it does | |---|---|---| | `/op` | `/op` | OptimusPrime control — status, repair, compact, slim | | `/optimusprime` | `/optimusprime` | Same as `/op`, longer form | | `/caveman` | `/caveman` | Terse output — drop filler, keep substance | | `/superpowers` | `/superpowers` | Full engineering rigor — plan, TDD, verify | | `/ponytail` | `/ponytail` | Minimal code — no abstractions until needed | | `/ui-ux-pro-max` | `/ui-ux-pro-max` | Design + accessibility review | | `/optimusprime-compact` | `/op compact` | Compress conversation history | **Requirements:** Python 3.8+ · macOS or Linux (Windows: WSL2)
Manual install ```bash git clone https://github.com/aarshsharma2803-stack/optimusprime cd optimusprime bash install.sh ```
--- ## Usage One command: **`/op`** (short) or **`/optimusprime`** (full) ``` /op → activate. New session: init. Existing: recover context. /op status → tokens, decisions, loop streak, compression /op compact → compress conversation history, keep decisions, drop filler /op slim → compact + escalate to ultra-terse for rest of session (max token efficiency) /op repair → show what failed, suggest a different approach /op tokens → usage + cost + recommendations /op dashboard → all of the above, one screen ``` Everything else runs silently. Scope blocks, loop catches, session writes, output compression — all via hooks, zero commands needed. --- ## Benchmarks | | Result | |---|---| | Scope guard | 82.6ms avg (n=1,000) | | Loop detection | 100% accuracy, 0 false positives (20 sequences) | | Output compression | 70.1% avg (benchmark suite) · 22.3% (real verbose response) | | Session logger | 0.13s avg (n=10) | [Full benchmark suite →](benchmarks/) --- ## Credits Built by **[Aarsh Sharma](https://github.com/aarshsharma2803-stack)**. MIT License. *Claude is stateless. Your project isn't.*
